comment: Authoritative effect-op vocabulary (docs/design/08 §7). Codegen emits the EffectOp enum from 'ops' IN ORDER (append new ops at the end to keep enum values stable). 'containers' are the keys whose arrays hold effect objects; the validator checks 'op' only there. Adding an op: append it here, run Tools/codegen.mjs, implement IEffectOp, add a test.
